name: Tesseract RAPID Profile
description: Bind exact Tesseract motion-profile names to native typed ABB RAPID speed, zone, tool, and workobject variables.

inputParameters.name: profile_names
inputParameters.description: Exact Tesseract profile names used by CompositeInstruction moves. Duplicate names fail loudly.

inputParameters.name: speed
inputParameters.description: ABB speeddata variable name. Defaults to controller built-in v200.

inputParameters.name: zone
inputParameters.description: ABB zonedata variable name. Defaults to controller built-in z10.

inputParameters.name: tool
inputParameters.description: ABB tooldata variable name. Defaults to controller built-in tool0.

inputParameters.name: workobject
inputParameters.description: ABB wobjdata variable name. Defaults to controller built-in wobj0.

outputParameters.name: profiles
outputParameters.description: Native dict[str, RapidProfile] retaining exact Tesseract profile names and typed RAPID variable references.
